narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with actual kinetic exchanges and strategic infrastructure strikes. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these conflicts, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; buy VIX calls.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a sustained oil supply disruption from the Strait of Hormuz blockade, with EIA timelines extending into 2027 and Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The SPR release is misinterpreted as bearish but actually signals government concern, reinforcing bullish oil positioning.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and Brent calendar spreads; short refined products.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's selloff mirrors broader risk-off moves, not crypto-specific issues, as institutional de-risking dominates. However, whale accumulation and MicroStrategy buying suggest dip-buying at lower levels, creating a potential divergence if geopolitical tensions ease.
narratives.trade_implication: Short BTC futures near resistance; accumulate long positions on dips below $60K.
